name: spec-constraint-scope
body: A constraint is prose ("X must hold"), and its layer is its scope: a `global.constraint.*` binds the whole durable spec for every APG instance, and a `<tier>.constraint.*` (requirements/domain/solution/implementation) binds that tier. A constraint names no node; `attaches-to` is not part of the model. Structure and references hold deterministically at write time; satisfaction of the prose holds by review.
